guardrails.attack: Known actuals were used to tune or rank the unknown candidates.
guardrails.answer: Known actuals are post-hoc checks only and are not used to generate unknown candidate cards or assign feasibility bands.

guardrails.attack: Known-control checks are being sold as corrosion or product performance.
guardrails.answer: Known-Control Recovery Check is pass/fail validation behavior; it is not a candidate evidence rank.

guardrails.attack: Partial-TDS anchors get the same credit as full-BOM controls.
guardrails.answer: Partial-TDS anchors are visibly marked KNOWN PARTIAL-TDS and cannot receive full-BOM recovery credit.
Unknown candidate cards are formulation chemistry concepts made from real sourced raw materials, with source IDs and grade classes rather than invented CAS numbers.

guardrails.attack: Cure and corrosion ranking are quietly restored through card prose.
guardrails.answer: Cure and corrosion remain failed/no-authority or directional until CRO data closes the registered bars.
